named-native-query.name: MarketPrice.ohlc
named-native-query.query:
SELECT item_blueprint_id,
coalesce( (Select m2.current_price from marketPrice m2 where m2.round_id = :startId and m2.item_blueprint_id = m.item_blueprint_id), (array_agg(currentPrice order by round_id ASC))[1]) as open,
max(current_price) as high, min(current_price) as low, (array_agg(current_price order by round_id DESC))[1] as close FROM marketPrice m WHERE round_id >= :startId AND round_id <= :endId GROUP BY item_blueprint_id
